scenes.title_cn: 街头搭话：指出跑姿问题
scenes.context: 跑者在公园遇到一位小哥哥，直话直说指出问题：脚后跟落地偏多、上身没收紧、仰着头，这样跑很累还可能受伤。真诚交流后对方同意接受指导。
sentences: 前面小哥哥跑姿不对，咱们交流一下。
That runner's form is off—let's have a chat.
你脚后跟落地偏多，上身没有收紧，还仰着头。
You heel-strike too much, your torso is loose, and you look up.
这样跑很累，我可以教你一种轻松还不受伤的跑法。
That's tiring—let me teach you an easy, injury-free way.
scenes.speak: That runner's form is off—let's have a chat. You heel-strike too much, your torso is loose, and you look up. That's tiring—let me teach you an easy, injury-free way.

scenes.context: 你的最大问题是脚后跟落地，再加上步频又低，跑久了膝盖百分之百会受伤。脚后跟落地是因为上身没有收紧，包括小腹腹部。
sentences: 你的最大问题是脚后跟落地。
Your biggest problem is landing on your heels.
再加上步频低，跑久膝盖一定会受伤。
Add a low cadence and your knees will suffer over time.
脚后跟落地是因为上身没有收紧。
Heel-striking comes from a loose upper body.
scenes.speak: Your biggest problem is landing on your heels. Add a low cadence and your knees will suffer over time. Heel-striking comes from a loose upper body.

scenes.title_en: Brace the Belly, Shrink the Stride
scenes.context: 让跑者按一下腹部确认收紧，然后把步幅再降低一点，你会感觉跑得更轻松一点。现在的步频才160，要提到180以上才不会受伤。
sentences: 腹部收紧，步幅再降低一点。
Brace the belly and take smaller steps.
180以上才不会受伤，感觉更轻松。
Above 180 spares the joints and feels easier.
scenes.speak: Brace the belly and take smaller steps. Your cadence is 160—get it above 180. Above 180 spares the joints and feels easier.

scenes.title_cn: 练小碎步找全脚掌落地
scenes.title_en: Shuffle Steps to Find the Full-Foot Landin…
scenes.context: 步子小一点，小碎步，不要点脚尖，不要用前脚掌落地，用整个脚落地。练习时张开手臂找平衡，像机器人一样直上直下走。
sentences: 不要点脚尖，用整个脚落地。
Don't tiptoe—land with the whole foot.
张开手臂找平衡，直上直下像机器人。
Open your arms for balance and step up-down like a robot.
scenes.speak: Take smaller steps—a light shuffle. Don't tiptoe—land with the whole foot. Open your arms for balance and step up-down like a robot.

scenes.title_cn: 摆臂：前后送不是往下敲
scenes.title_en: Arms Swing Front-Back, Not Punching Down
scenes.context: 摆臂不是往下敲，而是手肘固定、前后送，弯曲小于90度。翘手、往下敲都是错的，摆臂前后送才省力。
sentences: 摆臂不是往下敲，而是固定手肘前后送。
Don't punch downward—fix the elbow and swing front and back.
scenes.speak: Don't punch downward—fix the elbow and swing front and back. Bend the arm under 90 degrees. Front-back swinging saves energy.

scenes.context: 提醒吸气挺胸、头看斜下方不要扬头、脖子收起来、步子小着、上身稳住。慢跑时头微微往下看，一疲劳头就容易上扬。
sentences: 吸气挺胸，头看斜下方不要扬头。
Breathe in, chest up, eyes down—don't lift your chin.
脖子收起来，步子小着，上身稳住。
Tuck the neck, keep steps short, hold the torso steady.
Get tired and the head creeps up.
scenes.speak: Breathe in, chest up, eyes down—don't lift your chin. Tuck the neck, keep steps short, hold the torso steady. Get tired and the head creeps up.

scenes.context: 练了一会儿，步频从160提到166、接近180，保持住越来越好。教练肯定成果后离开，留下一句鼓励。
sentences: 练了一会儿，步频上来了。
After some drills, your cadence is climbing.
Hold it—you're getting better and better.
那我就走了，不打扰了，拜拜。
scenes.speak: After some drills, your cadence is climbing. Hold it—you're getting better and better. I'll leave you to it—bye!

practice: You heel-strike too much, your torso is loose, and you look up.
Heel-striking plus a low cadence will hurt your knees over time.
Take small shuffle steps and land with the whole foot.
Fix the elbow and swing front and back, bending under 90°.
Breathe in, chest up, eyes down—don't lift your chin.
pitfalls: It's braking with every step and loads the knees.
脚后跟落地多，膝盖会受伤。
Brace the belly to stabilize the upper body.
上身没收紧是脚后跟落地的原因。
Get it above 180 to spare the joints.
Punching the arms down when swinging.
Fix the elbow and swing front and back.
摆臂要前后送不是往下敲。
Letting the head creep up when tired.
Keep your eyes down and the neck tucked.
疲劳时头容易上扬，要往下看。
shifts: 用 form（跑姿）、cadence（步频）、heel-strike（脚后跟落地）
用 brace the belly（收紧腹部）、shuffle steps（小碎步）、streamline（流线型）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：街头教练主动指出跑姿问题（脚后跟落地偏多、上身没收紧、仰着头）、最大问题是脚后跟落地加上步频低跑久膝盖会受伤、脚后跟落地源于上身未收紧包括小腹、步频从160要提到180以上、练小碎步找全脚掌落地不要点脚尖、张开手臂找平衡像机器人直上直下走、摆臂不是往下敲而是固定手肘前后送弯曲小于90度、吸气挺胸头看斜下方不要扬头、一疲劳头就上扬、练后步频从160升到166接近180、保持住越来越好等。
